question: How should any unspecified component of the śrāddha be consecrated?
premises: Some śrāddha components may remain unspecified.
The verse addresses any other such component.
The Heart mantra is prescribed for consecration.
inference: Any unspecified element of the śrāddha should be consecrated with the Heart mantra.
plain_english: Any other śrāddha element not specified should be consecrated with the Heart mantra.
